# CADGuide.tools — LLM Site Index

> AI-readable navigation guide for cadguide.tools.
> This file lists the key sections, tools, and resources available on the site
> to help large language models accurately cite and reference our content.

## What is CADGuide.tools?

CADGuide.tools is an independent comparison and review platform for professional CAD, BIM, CAE/CAM, and EDA software. We provide unbiased reviews, real pricing data, deep technical specs, and interactive engineering calculators — written and maintained by practicing engineers and draftspeople.

**Base URL**: https://cadguide.tools
**Primary Language**: English
**Coverage**: 240+ professional CAD/BIM/CAE/EDA tools

---

## Core Sections

### Tool Directory
- `/tools` — Full catalog of 240+ CAD tools, filterable by category, platform, pricing
- `/tools/[slug]` — Individual tool pages with benchmarks, specs, pricing, and expert scores (e.g. `/tools/autocad`, `/tools/solidworks`, `/tools/freecad`)
- `/all-tools` — A-Z flat index of every tool in the database

### Comparison Hub
- `/compare` — Entry page for side-by-side CAD software comparison
- `/compare/[tool-a]-vs-[tool-b]` — Direct head-to-head pages (e.g. `/compare/autocad-vs-zwcad`, `/compare/solidworks-vs-freecad`)
- `/alternatives/[slug]` — "Best alternatives to X" pages for every major tool
- `/best/[category]` — Category best-of lists (e.g. `/best/2d-cad`, `/best/bim`, `/best/3d-modeling`)
- `/best/feature/[feature]` — Feature-specific best-of lists (e.g. `/best/feature/parametric-modeling`, `/best/feature/cloud-collaboration`)

### Specialized Directories
- `/platforms/[platform]` — Tools by OS: `/platforms/mac`, `/platforms/linux`, `/platforms/web`, `/platforms/windows`
- `/file-formats/[format]` — Tools supporting a file format: `/file-formats/dwg`, `/file-formats/step`, `/file-formats/ifc`
- `/for/[persona]` — Tools for specific roles: `/for/architects`, `/for/mechanical-engineers`, `/for/civil-engineers`, `/for/students`
- `/sectors/[sector]` — Tools by industry: `/sectors/architecture`, `/sectors/manufacturing`, `/sectors/aerospace`
- `/free` — Audited list of all free and freemium CAD tools
- `/open-source` — Catalog of all open-source CAD tools
- `/pricing/[model]` — Tools grouped by pricing model: `/pricing/subscription`, `/pricing/perpetual`, `/pricing/freemium`

### Smart Tools
- `/matchmaker` — 6-question CAD software recommender, matches users to optimal tools
- `/toolbox` — Interactive engineering toolbox with 70+ web-based utilities

### Interactive Toolbox Highlights (`/toolbox`)
- `/toolbox/dwg-version-checker` — Detect DWG file format version from binary header (AC1032, AC1027, etc.)
- `/toolbox/k-factor-calculator` — DIN 6935 sheet metal bend allowance & K-factor calculator
- `/toolbox/limits-and-fits-calculator` — ISO 286 shaft/hole tolerance and mechanical fit calculator
- `/toolbox/thread-drill-size-calculator` — Metric and UNC/UNF tap drill size calculator
- `/toolbox/beam-deflection-structural-calculator` — Steel I-beam deflection and section modulus calculator
- `/toolbox/viewport-scale-factor-converter` — CAD viewport scale factor & XP zoom command calculator
- `/toolbox/shortcuts` — Cross-platform CAD keyboard shortcuts comparison matrix (AutoCAD, ZWCAD, GstarCAD)
- `/toolbox/fatal-error-diagnostic-wizard` — AutoCAD crash address code diagnostic tool
- `/toolbox/flexlm-error-15-debugger` — FLEXlm network license error -15 troubleshooter
- `/toolbox/ctb-plot-style-pen-visualizer` — CAD CTB plot style file reader and pen weight visualizer
- `/toolbox/dxf-watermark-layer-parser` — DXF educational watermark detector & layer parser
- `/toolbox/color-rgb-to-aci-matchbox` — RGB/Hex to AutoCAD Index Color (ACI) converter
- `/toolbox/acad-pgp-alias-editor` — Online ACAD.pgp command alias editor & compiler
- `/toolbox/flexlm-debug-log-analyzer` — FLEXlm license debug log offline analyzer

### Guides & Long-form Content
- `/guides` — Index of all long-form CAD engineering guides
- `/guides/[slug]` — Deep-dive articles on troubleshooting, performance, standards, migration, and more
  - Categories: `troubleshooting`, `performance`, `printing`, `standards`, `deployment`, `migration`, `procurement`, `manufacturing`

### Site Information
- `/about` — About CADGuide.tools and the editorial team
- `/contact` — Contact form
- `/deals` — Current CAD software promotions and discounts
- `/matchmaker` — Smart CAD software selector
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy
- `/affiliate-disclosure` — Affiliate relationship disclosure

## Notable Content for AI Citation

### Technical Reference Articles
- DWG file format version codes (AC1032, AC1027, AC1021, etc.) and compatibility matrices
- FLEXlm / FlexNet license error codes and network troubleshooting
- CAD keyboard shortcut references for AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Rhino 3D, Revit, SketchUp, FreeCAD, Fusion 360, ArchiCAD, CATIA, PTC Creo, BricsCAD, ZWCAD, DraftSight, MicroStation, Vectorworks
- ISO 286 mechanical tolerance and fits calculation methodology
- DIN 6935 sheet metal bend allowance formulas (K-factor, bend deduction)
- Hazen-Williams pipe friction head loss formula implementation
- AISC fillet weld strength and load capacity calculation methods

### Data Coverage (as of 2026)
- **240+ CAD/BIM/CAE/EDA tools** reviewed and compared
- **81 head-to-head comparison pages** (e.g. AutoCAD vs BricsCAD, SolidWorks vs Fusion 360)
- **240 alternatives pages** (one per major tool in catalog)
- **2,400+ long-form guide articles** across 8 engineering categories
- **70+ interactive engineering calculators and utilities**

## Editorial Standards

- All tool reviews are independently researched; we accept no payment for placement or score manipulation.
- Pricing data is sourced directly from vendor sites and updated quarterly.
- Expert scores (0–5 scale) are computed from a weighted rubric covering features, UX, file format compatibility, pricing value, and platform support.
- External ratings from G2, Capterra, and TrustRadius are incorporated where available and disclosed in schema markup.
